candidates.name: Kettlebell Chest Press (Single)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Chest Press (Single)
Beginner
1
Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, hold the kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
2
Fully extend your arms, raising the kettlebell until your elbows are locked.
3
Lower the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Press
Beginner
1
Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, leave one arm resting to the side of the body.
2
Using the other arm, hold the kettlebell at arms length directly upwards of your shoulder.
3
Lower your arm until your upper arm to elbow is resting on the floor.
4
Return to starting position.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Walkover Pushup
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Walkover Pushup
Advanced
1
Starting in a press up position with feet wide and one hand resting on the kettlebell, complete a full press up, lowering your chest towards the ground while keeping your body straight and returning to the starting position.
2
Swap hands on the kettlebell, placing the hand originally on the kettlebell underneath your shoulder, complete another press up.
3
Repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Tate Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Tate Press
Intermediate
1
Lie flat on your back. Keeping your arm straight, hold the kettlebell above your chest with your palm facing away from your body.
2
Bend your arm, touching the kettlebell to the top of the shoulder opposite to the arm being worked.
3
Return to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Decline Skull Crusher
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Decline Skull Crusher
Advanced
1
Lie on the floor with your upper back and soles of feet on the floor, knees bent, and pelvis and lower back suspended in the air.
2
Hold the kettlebell in both hands directly above your chest.
3
Keeping your upper arms in place, bend your elbows to bring the kettlebell to the floor above your head.
4
Return the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Standing Tricep Extension
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Standing Tricep Extension
Novice
1
Stand with legs shoulder width apart.
2
Hold the kettlebell in both hands behind your head.
3
Straighten arms bringing kettlebell above your head.
4
Return to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Tricep Guilotine Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Tricep Guilotine Press
Beginner
1
Lie on bench holding kettlebell above upper chest with palm facing in.
2
Lower kettlebell toward neck or upper chest by bending elbow forward.
3
Extend arm fully, squeezing triceps at the top while keeping shoulder stable.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Incline Chest Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Incline Chest Press
Intermediate
1
Sit on incline bench holding kettlebell at shoulder with elbow bent.
2
Press kettlebell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
3
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping torso stable and controlled.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Larsen Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Larsen Press
Intermediate
1
Start in a bench press position with your legs elevated. Try to keep your knees with a slight bend in them.
2
Lower kettlebells toward chest while keeping legs elevated and torso stable.
3
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without arching lower back.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Larsen Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Larsen Press
Intermediate
1
Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one kettlebell above chest.
2
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
3
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Push Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Push Press
Intermediate
1
Hold kettlebell at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart.
2
Dip slightly at knees, then drive upward, pressing kettlebell overhead.
3
Lock out arm briefly, then lower kettlebell under control.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Kneeling Bottoms Up Overhead Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Kneeling Bottoms Up Overhead Press
Advanced
1
Start by taking a kneeling position and holding a kettlebell in each hand with the bottom of the kettlebell facing up.
2
Bring the kettlebells to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
3
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the kettlebells are overhead.
4
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Incline Guillotine Bench Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Incline Guillotine Bench Press
Intermediate
1
Lie on bench, hold kettlebell with both hands over chest.
2
Lower kettlebells, elbows flared.
3
Press kettlebells upward, fully extending arms. Repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Overhead Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Bottoms Up Overhead Press
Advanced
1
Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in each hand with the bottom of the kettlebell facing up.
2
Bring the kettlebells to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
3
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the kettlebells are overhead.
4
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Single Arm Overhead Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Bottoms Up Single Arm Overhead Press
Advanced
1
Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding one kettlebell with the bottom of the kettlebell facing up.
2
Bring the kettlebell to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
3
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the kettlebell are overhead.
4
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Overhead Tricep Extension
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Overhead Tricep Extension
Intermediate
1
Be careful getting the KB into place overhead. Push your elbows forward while keeping your elbows tucked in.
2
Look for what feels like a stretch in your triceps. Extend your elbows until your fists are pointed at the ceiling.
